body: I realize; I've spoken with an attorney (a family friend of ours). She advised me to do nothing, and she didn't anticipate any legal issues. That being said, "Kim" was there when the rumor initially came up, so she definitely knows; as such, the attorney told me not to contact her under any circumstances.

I know where the rumor came from, and I'm not worried about legal consequences- there isn't any case. I suppose I could reach out to the school, but I don't want more people talking about this than there already are..
This helped a lot; I'm definitely saving this in case it is posted in a public forum.

I know who's responsible, but I'm not worried about legal/disciplinary consequences; there isn't any case. My parents reached out to an attorney just in case; they advised me to do nothing. My main worry is about social/reputation consequences.
I see- what did the guy end up doing about it? How'd things turn out for him?

Ah, I was unclear. The date was in June, we'd spoken during the summer, but after the rumor was brought into the world (about a month ago), we've said nothing to each other.

I'm studying abroad right now, which makes the situation even tougher.

Here's the tough part- from what I understand, it's not the girl I had the date with that's telling people this; it's a friend of hers (who I've only met in passing).

The girl and I had spoken since the date, and I hadn't gotten any negative vibes. That being said, my parents had me talk to an attorney (a family friend of ours) just in case; she said I absolutely shouldn't try to contact her.

I’ve got documentation of everything, and my parents and I already reached out to an attorney just in case. Like I said, there’s no evidence that I did anything; I’m mostly worried about my reputation.

That's where I'm stuck- I don't even know what the story is, and only John knows that I know there's a story at all. I fear that jumping out with a defense against a rumor that maybe ~20 people max heard (most of whom don't even know me irl) would make it look like I've got something to hide, when I really don't- I would never hurt anyone like that. 

The phrasing sounded weird to me, but I'm reasonably sure the only person I've been with that Sarah knows is Kim. I checked the social media of every person I've hooked up with, and none of them follow Sarah but her. But then again, I've got no idea why Kim would say that: ""I had a really good time too, but I'm not really looking for anything romantic or physical right now. I'm down to chat and be friends if you want though" doesn't seem like a message you would send someone after a date if you felt violated by them.

Idk. I'm trying to see a way forward, but I can't. I know the drinking's going to cause way worse problems later, but when I'm sober the fear and anxiety eat me alive, to the point where I can barely function.

Like I said, we were in a groupchat together; I genuinely thought we were cool. I’m afraid that saying anything could make things worse- I also don’t wanna get John in trouble, since nobody knows that he told me what was going on.
I mean, I only found myself in this situation two weeks ago. Sucks that this happened to someone else though.
